meta.source: weekly harvest scan 2026-11-16 -- three parallel sweeps: (a) arXiv math.CO/math.NT (math.CO 356 entries enumerated 2026-11-09..13; math.NT no full listing enumeration, targeted search only); (b) arXiv math.PR/math.NA/cs.DM/cs.SC (cs.DM 11 primary + cs.SC 11 fully abs-page-checked; math.PR ~136 and math.NA ~130 keyword-screened, not title-enumerated); (c) math blogs, public GitHub repos, HexagonMath deposits and Zenodo records. Top code links spot-verified live by the parent: ternary-goldbach repo (public, 423 commits, current 60ac565, lean-toolchain present, full build 2026-11-14 at acb9dc7), pinwheel_scheduling repo (public, MIT, certificate dirs + checkers as documented), yang-mills-group/OpenAI-YM-20261028 (public, Lean 4.32.0, lean-toolchain + comparator.json -- see last_scan.md, registered-claim availability note, NOT a shortlist item). Registered candidate toric-code-lean-device-model: trigger checked (arXiv:2611.03329 still v1 only, no ancillary files, no repo link) -- not fired, stays WAITING, silent in delivery. Coverage caveats: math.NT title-level coverage thin (no full listing enumeration -- main gap in this slice); math.CO titles screened only for the latest ~15 entries plus keyword searches; math.PR Nov 13 entries 51-82 and the Nov 11/10/9 day-lists not title-enumerated; math.NA title-unscreened; announcements through Fri 13 Nov covered, Nov 14-15 weekend (no mail), Nov 16 mail visible at scan time; Hexagon/Zenodo discovery search-index based, Nov 14-16 deposits may exist beyond the index; gitlab.com is policy-blocked in this environment, so the Girsanov Lean repo URL could not be resolved (near-miss, recon may revisit). Cut by the 10-cap, held for next run if still fresh: 2611.11641 (collatz-syracuse-holomorphic, ancillary verified: single CollatzAttractor.lean + Python verifiers + JSON report, 20 Lean theorems cover local multiplier computations only), Hexagon 2610.00419v1 (finite-prime-gaps-h2-h5, H_2 <= 19,844 is ~80x weaker than the known Polymath bound 246).
